fusions.name: Stamp Order
fusions.desc: A stamping blow on a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. Anything struck moves 30% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Column Halt
fusions.desc: A stamping wave in a cone 3 tiles long deals 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Garrison Step
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 15% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sentry Stride
fusions.desc: You move 10% faster and have 8% physical resistance.
